structured_output.rationale: All three lines carry OA-22; claim-level MOA MA04 confirms primary payer adjudication data was absent. The 271 for the DOS explicitly identifies Novitas Solutions Medicare Part B (PI 1846349352) as primary payer ("PLAN IS PRIMARY PAYER FOR THIS MEMBER"). The 837P sent Keystone as primary (SBR*P, CI). Bill Medicare first; rebill Keystone secondary with Medicare's EOB.

root_cause.explanation: Claim billed to Keystone as primary (SBR*P/CI). 271 for DOS 2026-01-25 returns EB*R — Novitas Solutions Medicare Part B FFS — as primary payer with explicit MSG confirming it.

next_action.detail: Submit original claim to Novitas Solutions Medicare Part B (payer ID 1846349352). After Medicare adjudicates, rebill Keystone as secondary (SBR*S) attaching Medicare's CLP adjudication data (AMT/CAS/SVD) per 837P COB loops to avoid MA04 repeat.

evidence.fact: All three SVC lines carry CAS*OA*22; claim-level MOA MA04 — another payer is primary and its adjudication data is absent
EB*R loop names NOVITAS SOLUTIONS MEDICARE PART B FFS (PI 1846349352) with DTP*356*D8*20240101 effective and MSG: PLAN IS PRIMARY PAYER FOR THIS MEMBER
SBR*P (primary responsibility) with filing indicator CI — claim sent to Keystone as primary

citations.rule: CARC 22 alone → resubmit_other_payer; MA04 here is a consequence of missing primary adjudication data, not a separate defect requiring same-payer correction
EB*R proves another payer is on record; 271 MSG confirms Medicare Part B is primary for this member on DOS
